result.instructions: Tools for Lemon Squeezy, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lemon Squeezy data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run lemonsqueezy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lemonsqueezy_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lemonsqueezy_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. lemonsqueezy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_get_user

tools.description: Get the currently authenticated user/account behind the API key. Good first call to confirm auth. API: GET /users/me.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to sideload (JSON:API include=), e.g. 'store,variant'.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_create_checkout
tools.title: Create checkout
tools.description: WRITE: Create a hosted checkout / payment link for a store + variant. Returns the created checkout including its `url` (the shareable payment link). API: POST /checkouts.

product_options.description: JSON:API product_options object (name, description, redirect_url, etc.).

checkout_options.description: JSON:API checkout_options object (embed, media, button_color, etc.).

checkout_data.description: JSON:API checkout_data object (email, name, custom, discount_code, etc.).

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the checkout link expires.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_update_subscription
tools.title: Update subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Modify a LIVE subscription — change plan/tier (variant_id), cancel, pause/unpause, or set the billing anchor. This affects a real customer's billing. API: PATCH /subscriptions/{id}.

variant_id.description: New variant id to switch the plan/tier to.

cancelled.description: Set true to cancel, false to un-cancel.

pause.description: Pause object (mode, resumes_at), or null to unpause.

billing_anchor.description: Day of month (1-31) to anchor billing to.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Cancel a LIVE subscription. It remains active until the end of the current billing period, then moves to `cancelled`. This affects a real customer. API: DELETE /subscriptions/{id}.
